status: OPEN_CONTRACT; read-only differential evidence and unambiguous fixes authorized; no control authorization

subject.note: Original inventory baseline. Subsequent mapping changes are versioned by evidence_batches and their source hashes.

scope: All non-test Go files in importable module packages; examples/main programs and hidden tooling excluded. Exported declarations plus embedded relationships; promoted members resolve through embed rows. Public test helpers are included.

readonly-01.scope: 39 selected synthetic read observations; states unchanged, no full item equivalence

readonly-02.scope: Additive DHCP/DNS/SLAAC/policy read fields; 29 new mapping candidates, no full item equivalence

readonly-03.scope: PCIe device/function/interface read models and five topology readers; 48 new candidates; defaults, strict decoding and partial results differ

readonly-04.scope: Boot configuration/options, Secure Boot/database/signature reads; 42 new candidates; presence, inline and error differences retained; no compatibility-mode decision assumed

readonly-05.scope: TaskService/Task/Message reads and four explicit navigations; 34 new candidates; existing numeric, presence, eager decoding and partial-result differences retained; no polling or controls

readonly-06.scope: Certificate/CertificateIdentifier reads and six explicit navigations; 36 new candidates; metadata only, no cryptographic validation or control

defect_exception_policy.evidence_status: eight same-input generic numeric observations executed with both pinned DMTF implementations; typed-field validation/coercion coverage remains unestablished

row_id: package + :: + kind + :: + name; row line belongs to file.path

states.U: No reviewed full API mapping; gap/unverified, never assumed equivalent. Raw JSON access alone does not close it.
states.P: Existing overlapping implementation/candidate only; complete behavior and API remain unverified.
states.V: Verified equivalence under approved contract; currently zero.

phase_rule: File phase is model/read/support work only. Every callable requires side-effect review; mutations move to P4/P5, or P6 for OEM, only after separate approval. No phase label authorizes control development or real-device access.
